lldMapDialect.header: VMA      LMA     Size Align Out     In      Symbol
lldMapDialect.note: LLD does NOT emit a 'Memory Configuration' block. The map starts directly with a column header line (VMA LMA Size Align Out In Symbol) followed by section and symbol rows. Each section row shows VMA and LMA; for .data the VMA (0x20000000) differs from the LMA (0x08000074), proving LMA-in-FLASH / VMA-in-RAM.

dataSegmentLmaVma.note: readelf -l confirms p_vaddr=0x20000000 != p_paddr=0x08000074 for the LOAD segment containing .data

notes: LLD dialect sample. Compiled with /home/user/.swiftly/bin/clang (LLVM 21) --target=armv7em-none-eabi, linked with /home/user/.swiftly/bin/ld.lld. LLD maps have no 'Memory Configuration' block; memory regions must be parsed from the linker script or inferred from VMA/LMA ranges in the map. The Hexana parser needs to handle this dialect separately from GNU ld. arm-zephyr-eabi-size: text=116 data=256 bss=8192 dec=8564.
